name: Klarify
long_description:
Klarify handles every job a therapist does other than the therapy itself, from clinical notes and treatment plans to insurance claims and finding new clients.

Therapists hold the world together. They also run businesses, file insurance claims, write letters, fill forms, supervise new grads, and do hours of paperwork every night. 

Practice management software has existed for decades. It records what therapists do. It can't actually do any of it.

Klara is the AI at the heart of Klarify. She handles notes, treatment plans, clinical letters, insurance claims, between-session resources, supervision prep, and finding new clients.

Nearly 8,300 therapists use Klarify today.

Our mission is to empower therapists, not replace them. So they can focus on the one thing only a human can do. Be present with their client.

launches.title: Klarify 🌱 AI Agent for Therapists
launches.tagline: Klarify handles every job a therapist does other than the therapy itself.
launches.body:
Hey YC!

We're [Moody](https://www.linkedin.com/in/moodyabdul/) and [Bergie](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bergholmalexander/), co-founders of [Klarify](https://klarify.ca).

## TL;DR

Therapists work alone. Klarify is the AI agent that handles every job a therapist does other than the therapy itself: clinical notes, treatment plans, insurance claims, between-session resources, and finding new clients. Nearly 6,000 therapists use Klarify today, and we're growing fast.

**Ask:** Know a therapist or clinic owner? Send them this post or reach us at [moody@klarify.ca](mailto:moody@klarify.ca).

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K_xNXWnlf98>

## The Problem

Doctors have assistants. Lawyers have paralegals. Therapists work alone.

They spend their evenings on the work they didn't sign up for: clinical notes, treatment plans, finding new clients, fighting insurance denials.

Practice management software has existed for decades. It stores what therapists do. It can't actually do any of it.

Existing software stores notes but can't use them. Schedules clients but can't find new ones. Submits insurance claims but can't fight denials.

## Our Solution

Klarify does. Klara handles the work other than the therapy itself:

* 📝 **Notes**: drafted from the session in seconds
* 🩺 **Treatment plans**: personalized to each client
* ✉️ **Clinical letters**: referrals, third-party reports, court letters
* 🧾 **Insurance claims**: submitted, denials fought automatically
* 📋 **Between-session resources**: customized homework and client check-ins
* 📈 **Finding new clients**: AI-generated content that brings them in
* And much more…

> Klarify gave me something I didn't realize I had lost: time and energy. It has changed not only how I work, but how I live."\
> — Kelly Copeland, M.Ed, Registered Counselling Therapist

## Where We're Going

Mental health is a global problem. Every therapist, in every country, runs into the same wall: they're alone with the work no one trained them for.

US outpatient mental health alone is a $40B market. Klara works in any language.

In a few years, the solo therapist runs a 7-figure practice. The 50-clinician group runs lean. All due to Klarify handling everything other than the therapy itself.

## Our Ask

Therapists, try us free at [klarify.ca](http://klarify.ca).

For therapist intros, investors in health/AI/vertical SaaS, or press covering AI in healthcare or mental health innovation: [info@klarify.ca](mailto:info@klarify.ca)

## The Founders

We both have therapists who changed our lives. Klarify is what we wanted them to have.

**Moody (CEO)** is a second-time founder. He previously co-founded [Circleback.ai](http://Circleback.ai), an AI meeting notes app. Before that he sold $20M in enterprise contracts at LinkedIn. He hosts the Future of Therapy Podcast.

**Bergie (CTO)** has built LLM infrastructure at Workday. He holds a patent and a published paper from UBC in computer vision for self-driving cars, and researched deep learning with the Finnish Military's Special Task Force.
